title: Settings
description: Configure gateway routing, logging alerts, and overall appearance

callbacks.title: Active Logging Callbacks
callbacks.empty_desc: Add your first callback to start logging data to external services.
callbacks.read_only_title: Active callback that was not added through the dashboard. Edit it where it was configured.

alerts_panel.webhook_notice: Alerts are sent to any Slack-compatible incoming webhook URL (Slack, Rocket.Chat, Mattermost, etc.).
alerts_panel.alert_test_success: Alert test triggered. Test request to slack made - check logs/alerts on slack to verify

ui_theme.title: UI Theme Customization
ui_theme.subtitle: Customize your LiteLLM admin dashboard with a custom logo and favicon.
ui_theme.logo_hint: Enter a URL for your custom logo or leave empty for default
ui_theme.logo_dark_hint: Enter a URL for a logo suited to dark backgrounds, or leave empty to reuse the logo above
ui_theme.favicon_hint: Enter a URL for your custom favicon (.ico, .png, or .svg) or leave empty for default

api_ref.title: OpenAI Compatible Proxy: API Reference
api_ref.desc: LiteLLM is OpenAI Compatible. This means your API Key works with the OpenAI SDK. Just replace the base_url to point to your litellm proxy. Example Below

ms_teams.title: Microsoft Teams Alerting Settings
ms_teams.desc: Send alerts to a Microsoft Teams channel via an incoming webhook.
ms_teams.webhook_url_help: Incoming webhook URL for your Teams channel (Workflows or incoming webhook connector)
ms_teams.test_triggered: MS Teams test alert triggered. Check your Teams channel.

email.title: Email Server Settings
email.test_triggered: Email test triggered. Check your configured email inbox/logs.
email.smtp_host_help: Enter the SMTP host address, e.g. `smtp.resend.com`
email.smtp_port_help: Enter the SMTP port number, e.g. `587`
email.smtp_sender_help: Enter the sender email address, e.g. `sender@example.com`
email.test_email_help: Email Address to send `Test Email Alert` to. example: `info@example.com`
email.logo_url_help: (Optional) Customize the Logo that appears in the email, pass a url to your logo
email.support_contact_help: (Optional) Customize the support email address that appears in the email.

email_events.title: Email Notifications
email_events.desc: Select which events should trigger email notifications.
email_events.reset_success: Email event settings reset to defaults
email_events.virtual_key_created_desc: An email will be sent to the user when a new virtual key is created with their user ID
email_events.new_user_invitation_desc: An email will be sent to the email address of the user when a new user is created

page_visibility.title: Internal User Page Visibility
page_visibility.default_notice: By default, all pages are visible to internal users. Select specific pages to restrict visibility.
page_visibility.admin_pages_notice: Note: Only pages accessible to internal user roles are shown here. Admin-only pages are excluded as they cannot be made visible to internal users regardless of this setting.

user_banner.title: User Banner
user_banner.description: Publish an announcement to all dashboard users. Markdown is supported; the banner appears below the header on every page until you unpublish it. Users can dismiss it, and it reappears whenever the content changes.
user_banner.message_placeholder: **Scheduled maintenance** tonight at 10 PM UTC. See [status page](https://example.com).

sso.title: SSO Configuration
sso.empty_description: Configure Single Sign-On (SSO) to enable seamless authentication for your team members using your identity provider.
sso.delete_modal_message: Are you sure you want to clear all SSO settings? Users will no longer be able to login using SSO after this change.

cyberark.title: CyberArk Conjur
cyberark.hot_reloaded: Configuration changes are hot-reloaded across all proxy instances
cyberark.delete_modal_message: Models using CyberArk secrets will lose access to their API keys until a new configuration is saved.
cyberark.clear_field_message: This will remove the stored value.
cyberark.empty_desc: Configure CyberArk Conjur to securely manage provider API keys and secrets for your LiteLLM deployment.
